lectures.title: Welcome: Course Map and Career Paths
lectures.description: Course structure and weekly rhythm; cyber security landscape; CIA triad; risk, likelihood x impact; job roles and career paths; certification ladder; free vs paid platforms (THM/HTB/PortSwigger)

lectures.title: Ethics, Cyber Law and How to Learn
lectures.description: White/grey/black hat; authorization and scope; IT Act 2000 and DPDP; CERT-In and responsible disclosure; study method and structured note-taking

lectures.title: Data, Packets and the OSI Model plus Doubt class
lectures.description: Data and packets; encapsulation; OSI and TCP/IP models; ports; TCP vs UDP (Wireshark)
lectures.note: Cyber Security Lecture 04 - Summary Notes By Rishabh Sir.pdf

lectures.title: DNS, HTTP vs HTTPS and TLS
lectures.description: DNS records and resolution; HTTP vs HTTPS; TCP handshake; TLS handshake; certificates (dig, curl, Wireshark)
lectures.note: Cyber Security Lecture 05 - Summary Notes By Rishabh Sir.pdf

lectures.title: Problem Solving || Doubt Class
lectures.note: Cyber Security Lecture 06 - Summary Notes By Rishabh Sir.pdf

lectures.title: Web Fundamentals
lectures.description: Client-server; app architecture (thick/thin client, tiers); authN vs authZ; cookies and attributes (HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite); Same-Origin Policy and CORS

lectures.title: Kali Linux Install and Tools Overview Doubt Class
lectures.description: OS and virtualization basics; Kali install, update and snapshot; VM networking; Kali tool-category tour (info gathering, scanning, web, exploitation, password, wireless)

lectures.title: Linux Essentials for Hackers (Practice and Books)
lectures.description: Filesystem, files, permissions, users; processes, services, logs; grep/awk/sed & basic bash; practice: OverTheWire Bandit, Linux Journey, THM; books: Linux Basics for Hackers, The Linux Command Line
